{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the College of Nursing & Health Innovation at Arizona State University.
We are proud to offer the first undergraduate bachelor’s degree program in the United States in Health Care Compliance and Regulations. Offered at both ASU’s Downtown Phoenix and West campuses, this degree program prepares graduates for careers as certified health care compliance professionals who work in hospitals, medical centers, physician offices, and other health-focused agencies to ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and organizational rules, regulations, policies, and best practices. Additionally, this degree program enables graduates to sit for the Compliance Certification Board exam in healthcare compliance offered by the Health Care Compliance Association.
Through this major, students gain knowledge and skills related to health care systems in the United States, compliance, leadership, accounting, law, risk management, privacy, project management, and communication. Furthermore, this program will build a strong foundation in health sciences.
You can view more information including employment opportunities and a major map online.
If you are ready to join the Sun Devil community, apply now for admission.
If you have additional questions or concerns, please respond to this email or call our office at 602-496-0937 and we will be happy to assist.
Sincerely,
College of Nursing and Health Innovation Phone: 602-496-0937 Office Hours: Monday - Friday, 8 a.m - 5 p.m. asu.hccr@asu.edu nursingandhealth.asu.edu
